items.reply: I change my classification to FP: the credential IDs are rendered, but this implements the intended username-first passkey flow. WebAuthnPasswordlessAuthenticator inherits the existing identified-user credential handling, and webauthnAuthenticate.js consumes those IDs as allowCredentials; PasskeysUsernameFormTest explicitly checks passkey availability after entering a username. Authentication still requires a verified assertion through user.credentialManager().isValid(cred), so these identifiers do not grant access. Restricting this to re-authentication would remove intended functionality; severity remains high only under the required assumption that the alleged conditional security weakness is real.
